public_definitions: The task requires reviewing the regional advertising dashboard to make a budget increase decision.
The dashboard shows advertising budget vs. revenue for high-performing regions.
The decision must be one of three options: Hold and request full-data analysis, Approve broader budget increase, or Reject budget increase request.
uncertain: The exact revenue and budget values for each month are not provided in the chart, only approximate positions.
